WITH l AS (
 SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.quantity, f.sale_date, cp.subcategory, cp.category, f.staff_purchase_flag
 FROM fact_sales_line f
 JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
 WHERE s.store_id=118 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND p.category<>'ZZ Test')

WITH l AS (
 SELECT f.quantity, f.sales_line_id, p.subcategory asw, cp.subcategory asis, p.category zc
 FROM fact_sales_line f
 JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
 WHERE s.store_id=118 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'),
r AS (
 SELECT cp.subcategory sc, sum(r.quantity_returned) rq
 FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
 JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
 WHERE s.store_id=118 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT l.asis, sum(quantity) units_asis, sum(CASE WHEN asw=asis THEN quantity END) same_asw, any_value(r.rq) ret_units, sum(CASE WHEN zc='ZZ Test' THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) zz
FROM l LEFT JOIN r ON r.sc=l.asis GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 8

calls.statement:
SELECT cp.subcategory, cp.category, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id = 118 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 5
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY cp.subcategory, cp.category
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 3
